tools.name: tailor_analyze
tools.description: Inspect workspace technologies, frameworks, and reusable component catalog.

tools.name: tailor_reuse_search
tools.description: Search workspace for existing reusable components, utilities, and hooks before writing code.

query.description: Component, utility, or entity keyword to find (e.g. modal, user, date, dialog).

tools.name: tailor_spec_create
tools.description: Create a new Spec-Driven Development feature specification (spec.md).

featureName.description: Name of the feature (e.g. user-auth, payment-checkout).

overview.description: Brief overview of the feature goals.

tools.name: tailor_spec_plan
tools.description: Generate a reuse-aware technical implementation plan (plan.md) for a feature.

specIdentifier.description: Feature spec folder name or ID (e.g. 001, user-auth).

tools.name: tailor_security_scan
tools.description: Run static security rules to detect hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, and unsafe code.

tools.name: tailor_dependency_check
tools.description: Check a proposed package for bloat, redundancy, and license compatibility.

packageName.description: Name of the package to evaluate (e.g. is-odd, axios, lodash).

tools.name: tailor_pragmatism_check
tools.description: Evaluate code or package against the 7-step pragmatism ladder (YAGNI, stdlib, native API).

term.description: Feature, abstraction, or helper to evaluate.

proposedPackage.description: Optional package proposed for this task.

tools.name: tailor_memory_read
tools.description: Read the project constitution and progressive memory layer (.ai/).
